usedFor: Canny collects customer feedback, and HubSpot keeps the people when “New Post Created” runs “Create Contact”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Post Created” in Canny, then “Create Contact” in HubSpot
bestTemplate.why: Anyone who posts an idea becomes a HubSpot contact, so sales can see who is asking.

watchOut: “Create Contact” requires an email, so check that the Canny post carries one before you rely on it.
